purpose: Ask for or identify a minimum acceptable amount.
keywords: せめて + minimum; often だけ / でも
Please at least remember my name before you leave.
Even if I am busy, I want at least one day off.
Let us at least call to say we are safe.
formation: せめて + minimum; often だけ / でも
restrictions: The minimum is less than the ideal but still worth securing.
mistake: It does not mean a maximum limit.
